senses.gloss_en: little known, unfamiliar (previously encountered but not familiar or well-acquainted); unrecognized, unfamiliar, unidentified (previously encountered but not known by name or identity)
misunderstood (which is correctly recognized or identified, but whose true nature, qualities, character, etc. are not)
underappreciated, unrecognized (deserving or worthy of recognition that is not received)
